annotation.title_en: National AI Ethics Standards (National Archives of Korea topic page)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Archives of Korea (국가기록원); topic written by Mun A-ram (KISDI)
annotation.summary_en: National Archives of Korea topic page describing Korea's 2020 national AI Ethics Standards, adopted by the Presidential Committee on the Fourth Industrial Revolution. It outlines three basic principles (human dignity, public good, technological purposiveness) and ten core requirements, plus follow-up checklists, education and an AI ethics policy forum.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI Ethics Standards adopted 23 Dec 2020 by the Presidential 4th Industrial Revolution Committee
Three principles: human dignity, social public good, technology's purposiveness
Ten requirements: human rights, privacy, diversity, non-infringement, publicness, solidarity, data management, accountability, safety, transparency
Follow-up: checklists for developers, providers and users, and ethics education programs
AI Ethics Policy Forum launched 2022 to build social consensus
